title: Chapter 219: First Experience Of A Krypton Gold Player
content:
Chapter 219: First Experience Of A Krypton Gold Player

Wang Shuo looked at the territory's energy crystal reserves. After upgrading the barracks and purchasing the job transfer certificate, there are only more than 4.6 million left!

And with the increase of territory buildings, daily expenses are getting bigger and bigger.

Wang Shuo dare not squander it casually.

If it weren't for the benefits sent by Toad Brunei, Wana Village would probably be in a shortage of energy crystals at this time!

After thinking about it, Wang Shuo decided to take out 100,000 energy crystals and experience it!

Putting the "Black Dragon Sutra" on the bookshelf, Wang Shuo entered another room of the three-story hut.

Sitting on the futon, Wang Shuo opened up a tenfold cultivation speed.

The cultivation experience at this time is completely different from last night.

In front of Wang Shuo, a phantom that mirrored himself suddenly appeared.

I saw his limbs doing various movements. After a while, a trace of true qi condensed in his body, running slowly along the meridians...

Wang Shuo couldn't believe his eyes.

This is indeed the treatment of krypton gold players!

It was like someone was teaching you step by step, and it also provided 360-degree viewing without dead angles, and even playback.

Wang Shuo was very excited, and quickly followed suit and practiced seriously.

But, happy times are always short.

Wang Shuo had just touched the threshold and was in high spirits when the virtual image in front of him suddenly disappeared.

It was like just taking off his pants and was about to...

But suddenly someone knocked on the door!

"Fuck!"

Wang Shuo was dumbfounded. Without the guidance of the virtual image, Wang Shuo's condensed true energy collapsed all of a sudden, and his practice fell into a situation of crossing the river by feeling the stones.

After working hard for a while, Wang Shuo's face was black.

On his own, he couldn't get into the door in a short time.

Wang Shuo snorted and quickly recharged 100,000 energy crystals.

The virtual image appeared again, and the practice became smooth again.

Wang Shuo smiled, just like seeing a colored book, and his whole body exuded a feeling of heat!

But, the pleasure came quickly and went quickly!

100,000 energy crystals were used up again soon!

Wang Shuo gritted his teeth and recharged again!

Recharged again!

…

Well, krypton gold is fun for a while, and krypton gold is fun all the time!

Unknowingly, time passed quietly!

By the time Wang Shuo entered the first level of "Black Dragon Sutra", 2 hours had passed.

Wang Shuo, who came back to his senses, was so distressed that he couldn't breathe, and his face looked constipated.

1.2 million energy crystals were gone!

The regret after chopping off his hands was beyond words!

At this moment, the sound of the system prompt sounded.

Wang Shuo felt a little puzzled.

[Dear players, Zhao Bangde, who had served you before, is about to be reborn. Please rate his service. ]

Wang Shuo opened his mouth wide and was shocked. There is actually such a rating system?

At the same time, he was also happy for Zhao Bangde. Lao Zhao was finally "released from prison"!

Suddenly, a rating system popped up in front of Wang Shuo, with the phantom of five stars on it.

Wang Shuo clicked it, and the stars became solid.

A five-star review!

Below, a dialog box appeared.

[You can enter what you want to say to Zhao Bangde in this dialog box! ]

Wang Shuo thought about it, and Lao Zhao was a good teacher and friend to him, who answered many of his questions.

So he wrote on it: "A dragon goes out to sea, a tiger roars in the mountains, and a comeback will surely soar into the sky!"

After Wang Shuo clicked OK, a message popped up saying "Thank you for your five-star review"!
